STAR evaluation compares school-level student growth to Pennsylvania state rankings. PRC evaluation uses value-added modeling and measures student academic achievement, attendance, and course credits earned over a two-year cycle.

PRC: The bonus will use value-added modeling (VAM) of a team's contribution to student progress over the two (2) year looping cycle.
